# Theme reference

Locked palette as a swatch: [tokens.svg](tokens.svg). Hex values match `resources/css/tokens.css` and [look.md](../look.md).

Owner-console screens (agent list, VFS tree, instruction editor) are **visual reference for later tickets**. Do not implement owner auth or that chrome in the app shell.

Fonts: Manrope (UI) + IBM Plex Mono (paths / logs). Mark: geometric compass, amber on void, no character art, no gradients.
